## MultipleSequenceAlignmentProps.rowOrder property

Display order of the rows, as row ids, fully controlled. Ids not in `msa` are ignored and rows missing from it are appended in `msa` order — so a tree's leaf order can be passed as-is.

**Signature:**

```typescript
rowOrder?: string[];
```
